description: 9x9, Black has played D4, White to move. One move of history, so the history planes exercise the short-history case: D4 must appear in plane 7 (t-1) with planes 5 and 6 empty. Under schema 2 it landed in plane 5 and plane 7 was empty, which is how a pass is encoded - this golden changed because that was fixed, and any future change to it is a change to what the network is shown.
